sample.topic: Monthly operations report of a fictional delivery company (Dawnroad · 새벽길), built from the chart grammar Anthropic publishes in model launches and research posts

canvas.role: page background; also the paper inside a bordered launch figure (site gray-050)

card-2.role: the 'For reference' column of a comparison table (site gray-150)

mat.role: research figure mat (8px radius) behind a figure panel

panel.role: figure panel inside a mat, 16px radius

plot.role: code workbench window and the plot inside it

cloud.role: mat behind the code workbench (the product-page backdrop)

ink.role: titles, figure frames and axes, table rules, primary button, footer, tooltips

text-2.role: subtitles, captions, axis ticks and titles, notes (6.3:1 on canvas)

muted.role: the smallest text: section numbers, unselected tabs, mono labels (4.6:1 on canvas)

mark.role: gray marks that are not text: the 'by hand' bar, Other

grid.role: gridlines in bordered figures, cells a rival wins

hair.role: dividers, pill borders, the selected filter pill, light gridlines

hair-2.role: card top rules, secondary button and pager borders

on-dark-2.role: secondary text on ink, tooltip labels

accent.role: clay, the brand accent: the 3px outline of the subject column in a comparison table. Never a data series

accent-deep.role: clay for text or a clay control if one is ever needed

peach.role: cells where the subject wins in a comparison table

good.role: favourable change, text only (4.8:1 on canvas)

bad.role: unfavourable change, text only (5.3:1 on canvas)

validation.tool: dataviz validate_palette.js (OKLab), on paper #faf9f5, panel #fbf9f5 and white #ffffff
validation.categorical: orange/aqua/violet pass every check on paper and white: worst all-pairs CVD ΔE 9.2 (deutan, aqua↔orange), normal vision 27.6. Aqua is 2.67:1 on paper, so its marks carry a 1px ink outline and every chart has labels or a table
validation.reference: rival grays #73726c and #c2c0b6 are neutral by design (the chroma floor does not apply); with orange and aqua the all-pairs CVD floor stays 9.2 and normal vision 18.1. Light gray is 1.73:1, so its markers always carry the ink outline
validation.comparison: #b0aea5 dashed 2px against orange on white: CVD 13.0, normal 18.6; 2.2:1, so it is always dashed and end-labeled
validation.bars: subject #eb6834 vs by-hand #87867f on the panel: CVD 9.5, normal 17.8, both ≥ 3:1
validation.steps: best-so-far orange line vs tried points #a2a09c: CVD 12.0, normal 17.4; rejected changes also differ by shape (×)
validation.pair: before #6150d3 / after #4a7b00 pass every check on the panel: CVD 28.7, normal 32.9; both ≥ 4.5:1, so they also label their own values
validation.diverging: arms #eb9574→#aa4518 and #7db2f0→#1a64b0 each pass the ordinal checks (monotone, ΔL ≥ 0.06, light end ≥ 2:1); poles CVD 22.3, normal 27.3; the midpoint #d1cfc5 is neutral
validation.sequential: one blue hue, monotone lightness, every step ≥ 0.06 ΔL, light end ≥ 2:1 on paper and on white
validation.status: good 4.8:1 and bad 5.3:1 as text, but they do not separate for deutan vision (ΔE 2.8): status is never color alone — the value keeps its sign and the comparison words

code.note: every token color is ≥ 4.5:1 on white; comments are explanations, so they stay readable

serif.role: the lede under the headline and section intros; never bold

sans.role: everything else: headline 700, figure titles 600–700, labels, numbers, charts

mono.role: eyebrow, figure labels (FIGURE 2), pager, chips, file names, code

tableau.fonts: Tableau Book for text; Source Serif 4 only if installed on every viewing machine and the server
